name: Drift triage agent — retrain vs alert vs noop
description: ADK AgentEvaluator eval set (ADR 0006). Asserts the agent retrains only on a sustained breach, alerts on ambiguous warns, and noops on benign/seasonal drift. Thresholds in test_drift_eval.py; tune to installed google-adk version.

parts.text: {"action": "retrain", "severity": "breach", "drivers": ["affinity_score", "auction_pressure"], "retrain_lookback_days": 60, "justification": "affinity_score PSI 0.41 and auction_pressure 0.33 both breach (>=0.25); live model is 90d stale, so a 60d retrain should recover calibration."}

{"action": "alert", "severity": "warn", "drivers": ["device"], "retrain_lookback_days": 0, "justification": "device PSI 0.16 is in warn only; single feature, no breach — surface for a human to watch rather than auto-retrain."}
